getAnnouncementsFeed.query:
query getAnnouncementsFeed($organizationId: ID!, $first: Int, $after: String, $orderBy: ORDERBY_FIELD_ENUM, $orderByDirection: ORDER_BY_DIRECTION, $searchText: String, $createdAfter: String, $createdBefore: String, $studentIds: [ID!], $states: [CIRCULAR_STATE_ENUM!], $sharedWith: [CIRCULAR_SHARED_WITH_ENUM!], $createdBy: CIRCULAR_CREATED_BY_FILTER_ENUM, $createdByIds: [ID!], $curriculumProgramIds: [ID!], $academicYearId: ID!, $getFilteredAnnouncementsCount: Boolean = false, $isRead: Boolean, $courseIds: [ID!], $isRecipientsVisible: Boolean = false, $createdIn: CIRCULAR_ANNOUNCEMENT_TYPE_ENUM) {
  node(id: $organizationId, type: ORGANIZATION) {
    id
    ... on Organization {
      id
      circularFeedV3(input: {first: $first, after: $after, orderBy: $orderBy, orderByDirection: $orderByDirection, searchText: $searchText, createdAfter: $createdAfter, createdBefore: $createdBefore, states: $states, createdBy: $createdBy, createdByIds: $createdByIds, curriculumProgramIds: $curriculumProgramIds, academicYearId: $academicYearId, studentIds: $studentIds, sharedWith: $sharedWith, isRead: $isRead, courseIds: $courseIds, createdIn: $createdIn}) {
        pageInfo {
          hasNextPage
          endCursor
          __typename
        }
        edges {
          node {
            ...announcementItem
            coursesV2(input: {academicYearId: $academicYearId}) @include(if: $isRecipientsVisible) {
              totalCount
              __typename
            }
            recipients(input: {academicYearId: $academicYearId}) @include(if: $isRecipientsVisible) {
              totalCount
              __typename
            }
            entityMap {
              entityType
              schoolGroups {
                id
                __typename
              }
              __typename
            }
            __typename
          }
          __typename
        }
        countForFilters: totalCount(input: {searchText: $searchText, createdAfter: $createdAfter, createdBefore: $createdBefore, states: $states, createdBy: $createdBy, createdByIds: $createdByIds, curriculumProgramIds: $curriculumProgramIds, academicYearId: $academicYearId, studentIds: $studentIds, createdIn: $createdIn, courseIds: $courseIds, isRead: $isRead, sharedWith: $sharedWith}) @include(if: $getFilteredAnnouncementsCount)
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}

fragment announcementItem on Circular {
  id
  title
  bannerV2 {
    id
    url
    name
    type
    mimeType
    metadata
    __typename
  }
  description
  isPublished
  isArchived
  publishedAt
  isRead
  isNew
  updatedAt
  archivedAt
  createdBy {
    id
    firstName
    middleName
    lastName
    type
    email
    profileImage
    preferredName
    pronouns
    prefix
    suffix
    __typename
  }
  publishedBy {
    id
    firstName
    middleName
    lastName
    type
    email
    profileImage
    preferredName
    pronouns
    prefix
    suffix
    __typename
  }
  updatedBy {
    id
    firstName
    middleName
    lastName
    type
    email
    profileImage
    preferredName
    pronouns
    prefix
    suffix
    __typename
  }
  archivedBy {
    id
    firstName
    middleName
    lastName
    type
    email
    profileImage
    preferredName
    pronouns
    prefix
    suffix
    __typename
  }
  state
  isV2
  __typename
}
